title: Bayern-Cologne: Kane leads the line, Olise starts on the right
text:
Bayern-Cologne: Kane leads the line, Olise starts on the right Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board Squads 🇩🇪 Bundesliga 3h ago · November 20, 2026 Bayern-Cologne: Kane leads the line, Olise starts on the right
 Bayern host Cologne tonight at the Allianz Arena with Urbig in goal and Karl just behind Kane; Cologne sit 15th with two points from their last four.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 20, 2026 at 11:10 AM 
 Result Bayern München 1 – 1 1. FC Köln Friday 20 November Goals, ratings and stats → According to TuttoMercatoWeb, Vincent Kompany's Bayern Munich host Cologne tonight at the Allianz Arena, and the starting XI is already official. Harry Kane is the central striker, with Olise on the right, Brown on the left and Karl in the middle, while Urbig is in goal in a 4-2-3-1 with Kimmich and Pavlovic as the double pivot. Bayern share the top of the table with Borussia Dortmund after six wins and three draws in nine matches, and Dortmund play Gladbach tomorrow. Cologne, 15th, have taken just two points from their last four official games and line up in a 3-5-2 with El Mala and Maina up front.
